WPS_PluginDesc: WPS Office integration plugin. WPS uses its own Open/Save dialog rather than the Windows one, and this lets Lertaro fill in a path there (e.g. from the Quick Navigation menu).
Plugin_Comp_Desc_WPSFileDialogAdapter: Detects the Open/Save dialog of WPS Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation and PDF by its control structure (not window title, since WPS is localized) and lets Lertaro fill in its file name field.
